text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking across the academy grounds—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Late, I'm gonna be late~~! ...Eek!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I-I'm so sorry for bumping into you!
...I just transferred here, so I don't know my left from right yet..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "...If it's alright with you, could you show me around? This wonderful... Tracen Academy!"
choice_data_list: ...I'm pretty sure you've been enrolled here for a while...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
............
'Sudden Encounter Pattern' concluded. Minimal effectiveness.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Including standby time, it took over ten minutes. At this rate, capturing thousands... tens of thousands of fans would require an astronomical amount of effort.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I need to shorten the time and streamline the process... ...Back to the drawing board.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On another day, in the exact same spot on campus...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Ah... how tragic...! When all I wanted was to run more, so much more...!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "...The stars... are fading away..."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
............That is all.
"Tragic Heroine Pattern," verification concluded.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Assistance is unnecessary, please don't worry.
I see... So rescue activities could potentially
lead to a commotion...
choice_data_list: What have you been doing since earlier?
What have you been doing lately?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trial and error to become a truly beloved horse girl...
I suppose you could call it that.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Society says "one is loved because they're meant to be loved"...
but I don't believe the fans' hearts are so vague and indefinite.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By analyzing trends, accumulating research,
and approaching people's hearts with logic—beyond that,
one should surely be able to become a truly beloved horse girl.

It seems Royce and Royce's actions may be eccentric,
but at her core, there is a burning passion.
choice_data_list: Then what about expressing your charm straight and direct!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Straightforward...... Indeed.
I was so focused on devising schemes
that I completely forgot what's important!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Plans must be kept as simple as possible.
Straightforward feelings are the most certain, supreme strategy!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, that was very helpful!
...Now then, back to square one, Lois!
And then on another day, at the same location as before...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Tracen Academy, Royce and Royce!
With all my voice, I shall appeal straight down the middle!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Hooray, hooray, Tra-cen!
Let's go, let's go, Lo-is!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Root, root, root for me!
Glasses are my charming point, look at me!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...Eyelids slightly raised, whole body tensed up.
The indicated emotions are...... surprise, and confusion.
choice_data_list: ............Rather than charm, they just look perplexed...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh...
As expected, the path to becoming a truly beloved horse girl
is no simple matter...

Afterwards, Royce and Royce continued to rack her brains
over how to produce her own image...
